m301-addresses.observed_description: Four front doors side by side in one brick wall, seen straight on: blue with a brass 11, green with 12, red with 15 and yellow with 20. No other writing, no people.
m301-addresses.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo. The four brass house numbers are the intended numeric cue.
